decision: CLEAR for the test-only short/empty picker footer regression coverage
scope: Tests and audit documentation only; no production source, expected snapshots, or visual approvals changed.
review_findings: Existing 100-row zero-footer test remains unchanged and retains its live-row/viewport assertions.
New one-item and empty-result cases each test footer_rows(0) and footer_rows(1) at TrueColor, Ansi256, Ansi16, and Mono.
Each color/data case has an explicit positive control requiring the configured hint to render with a one-row footer; the zero-row assertion requires no hint.
Assertions are additive and not weakened. Harness is the existing public test support API.

regression_evidence.recorded_pre_fix: The prior independent packet reports a one-item zero-footer failure on ed5bda4 and candidate pass on 6cd63d2; empty case passed before and is preservation coverage.
regression_evidence.limitation: This review independently reran the new native tests at cf854, but did not rebuild/rerun the added tests against ed5bda4. The pre-fix red evidence is from the preserved prior independent public probe and committed audit, not a fresh rerun here.

coverage_limits: This is not full picker behavior, application integration, frozen baseline parity, or four-application acceptance.
No claim is made that the added tests alone establish all terminal frame state or functional behavior.
